about_the_game:
The following features will be unlocked with the Standard Edition Upgrade DLC.

As a bonus, you will also receive 1 Scout Ticket and 300 HoloCoins.

Additional selectable Hololive members

Sora Tokino, Robocosan, Miko Sakura, AZKi, Aki Rosenthal, Haato Akai, Matsuri Natsuiro, Ayame Nakiri, Choco Yuzuki, Subaru Oozora, Mio Ookami, Okayu Nekomata, Flare Shiranui, Noel Shirogane, Marine Houshou, Kanata Amane, Watame Tsunomaki, Towa Tokoyami, Luna Himemori, Nene Momosuzu, Botan Shishiro, Polka Omaru, La+ Darknesss, Lui Takane, Koyori Hakui, Chloe Sakamata, Iroha Kazama, Ao Hiodoshi, Kanade Otonose, Ririka Ichijou, Raden Juufuutei, Hajime Todoroki, and some Hololive members to be added after release.

Additional selectable mascot balloons

Ankimo, Robo-Server, 35P, Takoyaki, Pioneer, Sukon-bu, Roze-tai, Haaton, Matsurisu, NEKO, Poyoyo, Chocola, Subatomo, Miofa, Onigiryaa, Koronesuki, Elf Friend, Dainin-san, Ichimi Kuma, Upao, Chungus, Watamate, Vivi, Lunanight, Yukimin, Nekko, SSRB, Zain, Luitomo, Joshu-kun, Inu, Pokobee, Uni, Banpen, Rekioh, and some mascot balloons to be added after release.

Additional selectable stages

[JP] 0th Gen Pickup Stage
[JP] 1st Gen Pickup Stage
[JP] 2nd Gen Pickup Stage
[JP] Gamers Pickup Stage
[JP] 3rd Gen Pickup Stage
[JP] 4th Gen Pickup Stage
[JP] Nepolabo Pickup Stage
[JP] holoX Pickup Stage
[JP] ReGLOSS Pickup Stage
and some stages to be added after release.

A Pickup Stage is a shorter stage reconstructed mainly from generation-specific objects in the main stage.

Additional selectable difficulty settings

  • ENJOY Mode – An easy setting where balloons can be used without limit. Not eligible for rankings.

  • HARD Mode – A harder setting with fewer balloons. Clear rewards are increased.

  • AENBIEN Mode – A chaos mode with only the bare minimum number of balloons (Main Stage only).

Other fine-tuned adjustments vary depending on difficulty. Details can be checked in-game.
